layout.closeBody: All Trivia Game overlays will stop working until you turn the server on again by opening this app.

setup.testMessageDefault: Obs Trivia game chat test — if you see this, votes are ready!
setup.summarySendTest: Send a test message in chat
setup.logoutConfirm: Log out and remove the Twitch token from this browser and the server database?
setup.oauthStoredHint: Your OAuth token is stored in this browser. Continue to step 2 to connect chat on the server.
setup.signInHint: Sign in with Twitch so the app can read chat votes and post round messages. Scopes: chat:read, chat:edit.
setup.saveTokenHint: Save your OAuth token on the server so it can join Twitch IRC for A/B/C/D votes.
setup.testSentSuccess: Message sent — check your Twitch chat to confirm it appears.
setup.overlayHint1: Add each URL as a Browser Source in OBS or Streamlabs. Set width ~900, height ~600, and enable transparent background if your scene needs it.
setup.overlayHint2: If an overlay looks blank or stuck, right-click the Browser Source in OBS → Refresh (or toggle visibility) after this app is running.
setup.liveOverlayHint: Shows the active question, options, countdown, and votes.
setup.scoreboardOverlayHint: Shows the top scores during your stream.
setup.resetRoundConfirm: Reset round #? This clears all round history and votes. The next round will start at #1. Active rounds are cancelled without scoring.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Configure Twitch chat announcements, score display, overlay labels, and overlay styling.
settings.overlayLabelsHint: Text shown on the live round preview and OBS trivia overlay.
settings.roundLabelTemplateHint: Use {{roundToken}} for the round id. Default: {{roundDefault}}
settings.roundLabelIdleHint: Shown when no round is active. Default: {{idleDefault}}
settings.idleQuestionTextHint: Placeholder question body when idle. Default: {{idleQuestionDefault}}
settings.scoreMultiplierHint: Displayed score = stored points × multiplier. Default is 10. Must be a positive integer.
settings.multiplierInvalid: Score multiplier must be a positive integer (not 0 or negative).
settings.overlayCssHint: Applied to both the trivia and scoreboard OBS overlays. Prefer selectors from frontend/src/styles/overlay.css (for example .overlay-page, .overlay-card, .live-round-panel, .scoreboard-list). Changes apply within a few seconds (or refresh the browser source).
settings.mcpHint: Optional: edit via your own chatbot — with the app running, add this MCP server:

questions.emptyEdit: No questions yet. Add one to get started.
questions.emptyStream: No questions yet. Switch to Edit mode to add some.
questions.question: Question

scoreboard.title: Scoreboard
scoreboard.resetBody: This clears every score on the board. Type {{word}} to continue.
scoreboard.empty: No scores yet. Correct answers earn points when you stop a round.
